name: voxelcraft
description: A fully playable 3D Voxel Sandbox game inspired by Minecraft with procedural multi-biome terrain (Snowy Tundra, Cherry Grove, Desert, Plains, Ocean Reefs), real-time circular minimap, loading screen, 3D Steve character model, first-person animated arm & held tools, classic title screen, perspective toggle (1st/3rd person), and crafting.
